title: Observabilidad
scope: structured application logs with correlation/trace context
distributed tracing primitives and export-ready configuration
actionable alert signals and documented thresholds/interfaces
outOfScope: inventing an external telemetry vendor or alert destination

baseline.correlationLogging: backend/src/API/Middleware/CorrelationIdMiddleware.cs propagates X-Correlation-ID, TraceId, UserId and TenantId via ILogger scopes and records failures/duration
baseline.healthChecks: backend/src/API/Program.cs registers AddHealthChecks with BackOfficeContext database check and maps /health/live and /health/ready
baseline.applicationMetrics: BusquedaRendimientoMetricas records in-process search counters/history and threshold warnings
baseline.loggingConfig: backend/src/API/appsettings.json has standard Microsoft logging levels
baseline.telemetryExport: No OpenTelemetry/Prometheus exporter registration or package reference observed in the directed API inspection
baseline.genericRequestMetrics: No generic HTTP request metric pipeline observed beyond correlation middleware duration logging
baseline.alerting: No canonical alert contract/runbook or external alert destination observed in the directed inspection

gapsToResolve: Add standards-based metric/tracing instrumentation or equivalent export-ready primitives without requiring production credentials
Add generic request telemetry with bounded dimensions and no PII/secrets
Make alert thresholds/configuration explicit and safe; external destinations remain environment-owned
Preserve existing live/ready semantics and database readiness check
Add directed regression tests and causal CI evidence
acceptanceCriteria: Logs retain correlation/trace context and do not emit secrets or high-risk PII by design
Metrics cover request count, duration and failures with bounded labels
Tracing is standards-based/export-ready and startup remains functional when no external exporter is configured
Live and ready health endpoints remain available; readiness includes database health
Alert-worthy latency/error signals have explicit configurable thresholds and observable warning/error signals
Directed backend/security tests and build are terminal PASS with P0=0/P1=0
risks: high-cardinality tenant/user labels causing telemetry cost or privacy leakage
telemetry exporter outage affecting application availability
rollback: Revert only N8.12 observability commits/package/config changes; preserve pre-existing correlation middleware and health endpoints. No schema/data rollback is expected unless later evidence proves a DB change is required.
directedValidationPlan: tests for correlation header/scopes and request telemetry dimensions
tests for /health/live and /health/ready registration/behavior where harness permits
telemetry startup smoke test with exporter absent
dependency vulnerability audit if new packages are introduced
frontend tests only if a causal frontend delta is introduced
